seed.reason: User brief is execution-refinement only (accessibility, hierarchy, IA-promotion) with an explicit 'keep as system' list covering palette, type family, flat surfaces, and register. Rolling an unrequested decade/craft/ground-family seed would contradict the brief's own constraint against inventing brand moves. Decade, craft, and ground-family are held at their captured/current values rather than rolled.

anti_toolbox_audit.note: No agent-default reflexes introduced — every move in this direction is either an inherited value or a mechanical derivation from captured evidence (H2 size, CTA labels, fallback stacks).

brand_faithful_inversions: #ffffff retained as page ground (existing brand decision; #fff is canonical for Helvetia). The 'no pure white' impeccable rule is inverted per brand-faithful direction.
Color tokens retained in hex format (matches captured brand surface and DESIGN.md Stitch frontmatter convention). OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.

Saturated #000d6e retained as the primary brand color and as the default text color (existing brand uses it as the canonical voice, dual-role). The agent-default reflex toward tinted-neutral primaries or a separate text-gray is inverted per brand-faithful direction.

The four pastel accent tones (#fff9e8, #f9f3ff, #e9fbf7, #ffeef1) retained as reserved colors for the stat-tile and service-tile surfaces only (T-PALETTE resolution: keep, don't expand). The agent-default reflex to either spread accent colors across the system or reject a 4-hue accent family as too many is inverted here — see DESIGN.md § The Two-Tile Rule.

narrative.overview: Brand-faithful accessibility and hierarchy refresh — not a rebrand. See DESIGN.md Overview.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant brand color (#000d6e) carrying both text and action roles — unchanged
Four pastel accents reserved to stat/service tiles only — unchanged scope, confirmed second deployment
Modular type scale (38/30/24, major-third) replacing the ad-hoc 38/38/24/16 — the one structural token change

rules.name: The One-Navy Rule
rules.body: #000d6e stays both default text and primary action color. No neutral text-grey.

rules.name: The Two-Tile Rule
rules.body: The four pastel accents are reserved to stat tiles and service tiles only.

rules.name: The Distinct-Step Rule
rules.body: No two adjacent heading levels may compute to the same rendered size.

dos: Do keep #000d6e as both the default text color and the primary action color
Do keep the four pastel accents reserved to stat tiles and service tiles
Do give every heading level a visually distinct size
Do give every interactive element a programmatically discoverable, destination-specific accessible name
Do wrap primary content in exactly one main landmark
Do give carousels a visible, operable prev/next affordance
donts: Don't introduce a neutral-gray body-text color
Don't expand the pastel accent family beyond stat/service tiles
Don't add shadow usage the live site doesn't already have
Don't reuse identical CTA text for two links pointing at different destinations on the same page
Don't invent a logo variant, font weight, color, or customer/pricing number not present in the captured evidence
